Maria (Customer): Hey team — our vector DB started throwing 'dimension mismatch' errors after a deploy. We expect 1536-dim vectors but the embeddings coming back are 1024. This started ~2h ago. Anyone seen this before?

Alex (Support): Sorry you're hitting this, Maria. Can you paste a sample request/response (headers + body) or show the error from your DB? Quick question: did you recently rotate keys or change org config?

Maria (Customer): Error from our DB: `ERR: vector dim 1536 != 1024` (failed insert). Our code calls the Redwood embeddings endpoint, we haven't changed the code. Example response (redacted): `{"model": "emb-small-v1", "embedding": [ ... 1024 values ... ]}`. We expected `emb-large-v2` output (1536).

Alex (Support): Hm. Two hypotheses: 1) The request is being routed to a smaller model variant (fallback). 2) There's an auth/project routing mismatch and the request is hitting a different project/org that defaults to the smaller model. Can you share the exact headers you send (just names, not full keys)?

Maria (Customer): We use `Authorization: Bearer sk-live-...` and we set `X-Org-Id: org_12345`. No `X-Project-ID`. We also have an org-level default model configured in the console (emb-small-v1) — but we thought per-key overrides should win.

Sam (Eng-ML): Pinged. From the runtime side: we saw a spike in requests that had mismatched org header + API key combinations earlier. There's a routing edge-case where if the org header points to an org that has an org-default embedding model, and the API key belongs to a different org/project, the code path fell back to the org header's default rather than the API-key principal's model preference. Basically header precedence bug.

Ingrid (DevEx): Oof. That's a bad one. Can you reproduce locally with curl? If so, include these two variants: 1) Authorization using the key only 2) Authorization + explicit `X-Project-ID` or remove `X-Org-Id`.

Maria (Customer): Repro steps I used: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-live-abc" \
  -H "X-Org-Id: org_12345" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input": "hello world"}'
```
Response: `{"model":"emb-small-v1","embedding":[...1024 numbers...]}`

Alex (Support): Can you try removing the `X-Org-Id` header (or set the correct org for that key) and re-run? Also try adding `X-Project-ID: proj_67890` that belongs to the API key.

Maria (Customer): Removed header -> returns correct `emb-large-v2` (1536) ✅. Adding `X-Project-ID` with correct project id also returns `emb-large-v2`. So this is reproducible.

Sam (Eng-ML): Confirmed on our staging replay. Root cause: when both an API key and an explicit org header are present, the router incorrectly prioritized the header's org-default model config during model selection instead of the API key's project. Fix is queued: change precedence to always use the API key/project mapping for model selection; the org header can only be used for optional region routing but not for model defaults.

support-bot: Ticket created: SUP-2026-847. Assigned to Jamie (Tier2). Priority: P1 (customer facing).

Jamie (Tier2): I'll own the patch + rollout. Immediate mitigation: validate request server-side and return a clear 400 with reason when the selected model's embedding dim doesn't match the caller's expected project config. Also adding a warning in the response if `X-Org-Id` differs from API key org. Plan: hotfix branch -> canary deploy to staging -> production in 2h if green.

Alex (Support): For the customer: short-term workaround is to remove `X-Org-Id` from requests or include `X-Project-ID` matching the key. We'll also suggest rotating keys if org shuffling happened recently.

Ingrid (DevEx): We'll add a note in the docs and a FAQ entry: "Why am I seeing a different embedding model?" with examples for headers and expected precedence. Also adding an automated lint in our SDK to warn when users set mismatched org/project headers.

Maria (Customer): Thanks all — workaround applied and back to normal. Please keep me posted when the fix is deployed. Appreciate the quick triage :thumbsup:

Sam (Eng-ML): Logged followups: (1) router precedence bugfix PR #5523, (2) response validation to detect dim mismatch and return explicit 422 + helpful message, (3) telemetry flag to alert when model returned != project-configured model.

Alex (Support): Closing loop with customer after prod deploy. Will paste postmortem summary here once patch is live.

Jamie (Tier2): Deploy scheduled in 1.8h. Will post canary metrics + any anomalies.

Maria (Customer): Ping me when it's live and I'll remove the temporary project header change. Thanks!
